description: Stop following a leader: transitions the subscription to "stopped" so no new copy intents are generated. DESTRUCTIVE in that it ends an active money-adjacent follow — but it is a SOFT stop: execution history and earnings are preserved, and you can re-follow the same leader later with create_subscription. To merely halt copies temporarily without ending the follow, use update_subscription with status:"paused" instead. Returns the cancellation result. Requires THREE_WS_API_KEY.

id.description: UUID of the subscription to stop (from list_subscriptions).

name: cancel_subscription
title: Stop a copy-trade subscription
